name: SOAR
description: SOAR is a comprehensive benchmarking study evaluating large language models on cell type annotation tasks using single-cell genomics data. It assesses LLMs' ability to classify and annotate cell types across multiple datasets and species, including applications to multiomics data and chain-of-thought prompting for biological insights.
reputation: SOAR is a niche but relevant benchmark in computational biology, with growing interest for evaluating LLMs on single-cell annotation tasks.
notes: Evaluates instruction-tuned LLMs on 11 datasets spanning multiple cell types and species; includes cross-modality translation and chain-of-thought prompting.
